issues.sym: The engine cranks but will not fire, or it quits once fully warm and only restarts after it cools off.
issues.why: The sensor sits next to the bell housing where it takes a lot of engine heat, and over time it stops sending a clean signal, so the computer cuts spark.
issues.next: Have the sensor and its wiring tested and replace the sensor if it is weak. It is one of the most common no-start causes on the XJ.

issues.t: Rear main seal and oil filter adapter leaks
issues.sym: Oil drips where the engine bolts to the transmission, or an oily film along the bottom of the engine.
issues.why: The rear main seal seeps with age. The gaskets at the oil filter adapter and the valve cover also leak and are easily mistaken for a main seal leak.
issues.next: Rule out the cheaper filter adapter and valve cover gaskets first. Watch the oil level and fix bigger leaks before oil reaches the exhaust.

issues.sym: A ticking or puffing sound from the engine bay, loudest when cold or under throttle, sometimes with an exhaust smell or a little less power.
issues.why: The factory manifold flexes through many heat cycles and the welded joints split over time.
issues.next: Have it checked for cracks and replaced with an updated manifold and a good gasket. Do not let exhaust fumes reach the cabin.

issues.t: Rust in floor pans and frame rails
issues.sym: Wet carpets, holes in the floor, or rot along the rocker panels and the rails under the body.
issues.why: The XJ has a unibody, so the floor and rails carry the load. Salt and trapped water eat through them over the years.
issues.next: Look underneath carefully, especially before buying. Rust in structural areas needs welded repair, not a cosmetic patch.

issues.sym: Coolant keeps disappearing with no visible leak, overheating, white exhaust smoke, or milky oil.
issues.why: Late XJs used a head casting marked 0331 that is prone to cracking, especially after the engine runs hot, letting coolant seep into the cylinders or oil.
issues.next: Stop driving if it overheats. Have a cooling-system pressure test and combustion-gas test done, and if the head is cracked replace it with an updated casting.

issues.t: Power window switch and regulator failures
issues.sym: One or more windows stop moving, only the driver's switch works, or the door locks act up.
issues.why: The driver's master switch and the window regulators wear out on the later XJ.
issues.next: Have the master switch tested first, then the regulator and motor for the affected window.

issues.t: Rough, delayed or erratic shifting from the 9-speed automatic
issues.sym: Harsh or late shifts, hesitation pulling away, lurching at low speed, or hunting between gears.
issues.why: The early 9-speed automatic had software and calibration problems. Jeep released several control-module updates, which helped some vehicles more than others.
issues.next: Ask the dealer whether the latest transmission software is installed and check the VIN for open recalls.

issues.t: Transmission may shift to neutral without warning (recall)
issues.sym: The SUV suddenly loses drive while moving, as if it slipped into neutral, sometimes with a warning message.
issues.why: A wiring problem in the 9-speed transmission's range sensor circuit could make the computer select neutral. Jeep recalled these years, and 2014 V6 models got a later software recall as well.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls right away and have them done before relying on the vehicle in traffic.

issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive, grinding or clunking from underneath, a 4WD warning, or the vehicle rolling while the shifter is in Park.
issues.why: Parts inside the power transfer unit can wear or break and disconnect the wheels from the transmission. Several recalls cover different build ranges.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls now and always set the parking brake when parked until the unit is inspected.

issues.sym: The oil level drops between changes, the low oil light comes on, or the engine stalls, often in turns when the oil is low.
issues.why: The piston oil control rings on this engine can wear and let oil burn off. Jeep ran an oil consumption test program and a class-action settlement extended coverage on many earlier-built engines.
issues.next: Check the oil at every fill-up and top it off. Ask a dealer for an oil consumption test and whether your VIN has extended coverage.

issues.sym: Oil pressure warning, engine noise, or the engine shutting off while driving.
issues.why: The oil pump housing on some engines could crack, cutting off oil pressure. Jeep recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls. If the oil pressure light comes on, pull over and shut the engine off.

issues.sym: Clunking or loose feel in the steering, or a sudden loss of steering control.
issues.why: A gear inside the steering rack on some vehicles could break. Jeep recalled affected SUVs for inspection and repair.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have it fixed before regular driving. Any odd steering feel needs prompt attention.

issues.t: Side air bags may deploy unexpectedly (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may be on, or the side curtain and seat airbags go off without a crash.
issues.why: A problem with the side impact sensing on vehicles built from early 2013 through late 2014 could fire the side airbags without a collision. Jeep recalled them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and get the remedy done. Have any airbag warning light looked at promptly.

issues.sym: A lateral shake or wobble felt at low speed while gently accelerating.
issues.why: Jeep traced this to the front half-shafts and issued a bulletin that calls for inspecting and possibly replacing both of them.
issues.next: Have a dealer check whether the bulletin applies to your vehicle and inspect the front axle shafts.

issues.t: Turn signal cancels on its own (recall)
issues.sym: The turn signal shuts off by itself before you turn the steering wheel.
issues.why: The steering column control module could cancel the signal without input, which does not meet federal standards. Jeep recalled these SUVs.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and have the column module inspected or replaced.
